newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco tightens legislation on tax evasion.
newsitem.headline: Morocco tightens legislation on tax evasion.

text.p: Morocco plans to deter tax evasion with fines of up to 50,000 dirhams ($5,319), and jail terms of up to five years for repeat offenders.
The penalties come into force from the start of July, the finance ministry said on Friday.
"So far when tax controllers discovered evasion, they requested people to pay, without resorting to imprisonment ," a spokeswoman at the finance ministry said.
Evaders had to pay additional tax assessments for the four previous years, in addition to a 25 percent increase in their tax bill.
"These measures will be kept in force and will be reinforced by the new legislation," a tax consultant said.

Under the new law which will be effective next month, fake invoices, falsification or destruction of accounts and the repeated absence of purchase bills will be considered as violations, the ministry said.
